task_description: Build an institutional-grade ADAPTIVE grid + basket-recovery (bounded martingale) MT5 Expert Advisor in MQL5 for XAUUSD, running 24/7. The bot dynamically decides grid spacing (ATR/volatility-based), lot progression, and recovery aggression from live market conditions. Enum-based presets (Micro/Medium/Large/BigLevel/Commercial) scale lots, grid levels, risk %, and exposure. Deep multi-indicator + price-action analysis drives entries and recovery confirmation. A margin/exposure-aware Safety Valve plus a per-preset drawdown circuit breaker blocks NEW entries when the account is in danger but NEVER force-closes at a loss and NEVER halts the account; recovery manages the whole basket toward a group take-profit. Optional Phase-2 ONNX ML inference hook is stubbed and disabled by default (no fake ML claims). Backtest-first; cannot be compiled/backtested in this sandbox (no MT5/MetaEditor), so verification here is by inspection and the README documents user-side compile + Strategy Tester steps.

verification.summary: No MQL5 compiler / MetaEditor / MT5 / wine in the sandbox, so compilation (.mq5->.ex5) and Strategy Tester backtests are DEFERRED to the user and documented as such in the README. In-sandbox verification was rigorous static inspection: (1) all 9 .mqh have matching #ifndef/#define/#endif guards and the main .mq5 correctly has none; (2) braces balance in every file; (3) main EA uses angle-bracket includes <AdaptiveGoldGrid/...> that resolve from <MT5>/MQL5/Include; (4) SafetyValve.mqh contains NO PositionClose/CloseBasket/ExpertRemove in any code path (comments only) - it blocks new entries only, never force-closes or halts, per the user's non-negotiable requirement; (5) RecoveryEngine only calls CloseBasket when basket PnL>0 (profit-only); (6) every order intent (seed/avg/hedge) routes through ExecuteIntentGated -> SafetyValve.CanOpenNew before any OrderManager send; (7) LotSizer clamps to max_lot_cap, bounds by max_basket_exposure_lots, and normalizes to broker step (bounded martingale); (8) EnableOnnxML defaults false and is advisory-only, can never bypass the SafetyValve; MLHook is inference-only with TODO(Phase-2) markers and no ML mislabeling of classical signals; (9) README five-preset table values match Config.mqh literals exactly (spot-checked base_lot, max_grid_levels, max_lot_cap, exposure, margin floor); (10) no .ex5 committed. No automated unit-test framework exists for MQL5 in this environment, so test_quality is n/a; correctness was assessed by logic-path inspection.
